material.description: aluminum or steel. Omit for both.

query.description: Free text: a name, brand or use, e.g. "hp100", "al80", "luxfer", "sidemount". A number matches the water volume in L, the rated ft³, the working pressure in bar or the number in the name: "12" finds 12 L cylinders, "80" finds the AL80 and HP80. Every word must match. Omit for every cylinder.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.
